'''Emili Pérez Font''' (born 3 October 1966) is an Andorran former [[Cycle sport|cyclist]]. He competed at the [[1988 Summer Olympics]] and the [[1992 Summer Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/pe/emili-perez-1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418122417/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/pe/emili-perez-1.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=18 April 2020 |title=Emili Pérez Olympic Results |accessdate=6 July 2016}}</ref>
